current_answer: As of October 5, 2026, Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list Grand Theft Auto VI for November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No official schedule change was found in the sources checked. The Miami HEAT and Rockstar announced a November 18 event; that confirms planned promotion, not game readiness or a guaranteed launch. catalogue_card.question: Is GTA 6 still listed for November 19?
catalogue_card.text: Yes. Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. A new Miami HEAT–Rockstar event is scheduled for November 18, but it is marketing, not proof that the game is finished. PC remains unannounced.

summary: Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
No official date or platform change was found in the source set checked on October 5.
Miami HEAT and Rockstar announced “A Night in Vice City” for November 18, the eve of the target date. It supports campaign activity, not delivery confidence.
Take-Two’s August outlook still names the launch date and lists timely delivery among its assumptions. Two previous public date movements also limit certainty.
No official PC platform or date appears. PlayStation labels PS5 Pro Enhanced but publishes no performance target or Pro requirement.

Rockstar says the physical box contains a download code and may be available from November 12 for preload. Check a named retailer for its own dispatch and delivery promise; play is still scheduled for November 19.
The alleged performer NDA reminder still traces through one podcast; it is not an official schedule statement or independent evidence.
The analytics broker was unavailable, so pool traffic, source clicks, decisions, return use, and revenue remain unknown.
uncertainty: November 19 is an official console commitment, not a delivery guarantee; two earlier official date movements remain relevant.
The November 18 promotion and other launch plans confirm campaign activity, not a finished build or certainty that the date cannot move.
Take-Two’s outlook is forward-looking and includes timely delivery as an assumption.
The physical-box availability guidance does not promise a named retailer’s individual order delivery.
No official PC platform or date is published; historical port timing and general company PC strategy are not GTA VI commitments.
The performer NDA claim has one reported source chain and no independent confirmation in the reviewed articles.
The analytics broker was unavailable; no first-party pool use or revenue was observed.
